maria_cs: FYI Helio onboarding stalled during SDK init. They turned on an Okta proxy and now see sporadic 401s followed by 429s on retries. Needs quick triage before demo next week.
helio_dev: Repro steps: cold-start WebView -> POST /v1/init -> sometimes 401, immediate client retry -> 429. Happens in corp networks only. Logs: `[2026-03-21T09:03:11Z] 401 invalid_token`, then `[2026-03-21T09:03:11Z] 429 rate_limited` right after.
eli_engineer: Can you paste request headers (strip tokens)? suspect proxy injecting or duplicating auth headers which confuses our JWT validator.
helio_dev: Sanitized headers: `Authorization: Bearer REDACTED`, `Authorization: Bearer REDACTED`, `User-Agent: Helio/1.2.3 (Android WebView)`, `X-Okta-Proxy: true`, `X-Forwarded-For: 10.8.9.10`. We saw two Authorization lines sometimes.
sam_devex: Two Authorization headers is a red flag. Our server currently validates the first header only; if proxy rewrote the header and left the original, validation can fail even though a later header is valid. Then client retries immediately -> fanout -> 429. Recommend client-side header sanitization + exponential backoff on 401.
julie_support: Customer reports it began after we shortened ephemeral token TTL. Might be timing/jitter + proxy rewrite behavior. Also calling out renewal risk: demo uses this flow. Flag AM.
maria_cs: Action list: 1) Eng check server behavior for multiple Authorization headers and consider tolerant parsing. 2) DevEx provide quick patch snippet to ensure single Authorization in WebView. 3) Ask Helio to toggle Okta passthrough for short repro window.
eli_engineer: Quick engineering note: small change to try all Authorization headers in order until one validates seems low-risk. I'll run it in staging and produce a PR if it passes. Draft PR: https://r.redwood/infra/pull/418 (WIP).
sam_devex: Client-side suggestion for WebView (Android): `// ensure only one Authorization header before send
List<String> auths = request.headers("Authorization");
if (auths.size() > 1) { request.header("Authorization", auths.get(auths.size()-1)); }
// backoff on 401: 200ms -> 500ms -> 1s jitter`
helio_dev: We'll flip Okta passthrough off for 15m and push a header-cleaning hotfix to the WebView. Reporting results in ~12m.
ops-bot: incident created: CS-1911-okta-auth-fanout (priority: medium) - assigned to eli_engineer.
eli_engineer: Staging experiment: server currently uses first Authorization header only. Implemented logic to iterate headers and attempt validation in reverse-order; test suite passes locally. Pushed WIP PR linked above. Concern: need to ensure change doesn't hide misconfigurations where token spoofing could be problematic. Will add audit log when multiple headers seen.
julie_support: Noted, will inform AM & mark as potential renewal blocker until confirmed fixed.
maria_cs: Thanks team. Helio, if passthrough toggle reproduces the issue, we'll fast-track the server patch behind a feature flag and coordinate a maintenance window.
helio_dev: Passthrough toggle window: turned off now. Initial logs show fewer 401s. After pushing header-cleaner, we saw a clean init flow for 30 devices. Will keep monitoring for 20m and update.
sam_devex: If you need a quick temporary mitigation for other customers, advise adding a CDN/edge rule to strip duplicate Authorization headers upstream of our API.
eli_engineer: I'll finalize PR with audit logging and a toggle. If QA green, we can roll to canary tonight.
maria_cs: Great. I'll update the customer record and schedule follow-up call with Helio and AM tomorrow. :calendar: 
julie_support: Logged the customer impact and added renewal flag to the account ticket.
helio_dev: Confirmed stable during the 20m window. Thanks everyone for quick responses.
ops-bot: incident CS-1911-okta-auth-fanout resolved (monitoring) at 2026-03-21T09:30:50Z."
